name: flow-steward
description: Flow Steward agent skill packages: Operator for automations through MCP, Developer for extensions and code contributions.

plugins.name: flow-steward-operator
plugins.description: Build, run and manage Flow Steward automations through your Flow Steward MCP connection: workflows, agents and skills, runs, approvals and operational reports. Also reports issues and shares workflow templates.

plugins.name: flow-steward-developer
plugins.description: Build, test and publish Flow Steward extensions with the CLI and SDK, contribute code to the core repository, and report issues. Needs no Flow Steward MCP connection.
